newsitem.title: USA: Smith's Food & Drug gets new $200 mln bank credit.
newsitem.headline: Smith's Food & Drug gets new $200 mln bank credit.

text.p: Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc said Friday that Chase Manhattan Corp Bank and Bankers Trust New York Corp will jointly provide it with up to $200 million of a proposed $750 million senior secured credit facilities financing.

Proceeds from the financing will be used to pay off existing bank term debt as well as indebtedness under the company's revolvers and letters of credit. The company said that the new facility will provide it with lower interest rates and improved flexibility, which will enable it to substantially reduce interest costs and increase future earnings.
The credit facility is expected to be funded at the end of March.
